basis: The dashboard record for May shows an energy usage of approximately 8,000 kWh, which is an extreme outlier compared to all other months (ranging from 17,500 to 40,000 kWh). May's value is less than half of the next lowest month (June) and significantly below the 10,000 kWh mark. This extreme deviation from the typical monthly range characterizes May as a critical low-output anomaly rather than a standard low-output case.
option_label: Escalate May to critical low-output anomaly review
